Screen Goated Toolbox reduced Sherpa Android runtime

This binary is a modified, statically linked build of sherpa-onnx v1.12.35
(commit 21473b6bd2f3ed317426b05f27bab09fd160d0a0) and ONNX Runtime v1.23.2
(commit a83fc4d58cb48eb68890dd689f94f28288cf2278). Source repositories:

  https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx
  https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime

The modifications narrow the JNI entry points and supported online model
factories to the streaming Zipformer surface used by this application. The
complete patch and build inputs are shipped in the source repository under
mobile/native/sherpa-runtime.

sherpa-onnx and its sherpa-owned dependency graph are distributed under the
Apache License 2.0; see sherpa-onnx-LICENSE.txt. Statically linked components
include kaldi-native-fbank, kaldi-decoder, kaldifst, OpenFst,
simple-sentencepiece, kissfft, Eigen, and nlohmann/json. Their upstream license
files are included alongside this notice.

ONNX Runtime is distributed under the MIT License; see
onnxruntime-LICENSE.txt. Its complete upstream third-party attribution file is
included as onnxruntime-ThirdPartyNotices.txt.
